summary.text: Monica Stonier is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 49-Position 2, where she has served since January 2017, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She is an instructional coach in Evergreen Public Schools and earlier served a term representing the 17th District.

paragraphs.text: Monica Stonier was born at Edwards Air Force Base in California and comes from a military family, according to her House Democrats' profile.

She has nearly two decades of experience in public education as a middle school teacher, instructional coach and professional development provider, and still works as an instructional coach in Evergreen Public Schools.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Western Washington University (1999) and a graduate degree from Washington State University Vancouver.
Stonier represented District 17-Position 1 in the Washington House from 2013 to 2015 and took office in District 49-Position 2 on January 9, 2017.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Appropriations, Education, Health Care and Wellness, and House Rules.
She and her husband have been married since 2001 and have two children.
